parameters.query:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN cs_week_beg_dt::date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
  l1_topic,
  SUM(sr_cnt::bigint)             AS sr_cnt,
  SUM(csat_sum::bigint)           AS csat_sum,
  SUM(csat_response_cnt::bigint)  AS csat_response_cnt,
  SUM(rsltn_cnt::bigint)          AS rsltn_cnt,
  SUM(rsltn_response_cnt::bigint) AS rsltn_response_cnt
FROM public.cs_contacts
WHERE (cs_week_beg_dt::date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    OR cs_week_beg_dt::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date)
  AND ($5 = 'ALL' OR country      = $5)
  AND ($6 = 'ALL' OR channel_type = $6)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
